subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps / calendar sync
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: James Turner <james.turner@nimbushealth.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@nh-prod.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps / calendar sync

Hi James / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposal for next steps so we can size dedicated capacity accurately: 

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary use: inference for conversational triage + summarization across the Nimbus patient portal.
- Model: planning to run a 13B open model (ensemble of smaller variants for different routes).
- Traffic profile: ~120 RPS average, ~380 RPS peak (bursty around business hours), ~150 tokens / request average.
- SLOs: target P95 latency <= 300ms for typical prompt lengths; tolerable background batching for cheaper paths.
- Security: SOC2 required, VPC/private deployment preferred for PHI; procurement will need evidence.

What we propose
- Schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with our solutions engineer to align on traffic profile, payload sizes, and latency targets so we can recommend a Dedicated configuration and estimated monthly commit.
- Suggested agenda: 1) traffic & payload walkthrough, 2) model/quantization options, 3) latency/throughput targets and what that implies for GPUs / capacity, 4) security/compliance checklist, 5) next steps & timeline.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed, Dec 2 — 2:00pm–3:00pm PST
- Thu, Dec 3 — 9:00am–10:00am PST
- Fri, Dec 4 — 10:00am–11:00am PST

I've attached the sample traffic CSV you promised earlier (nimbus_api_sample_rates.csv) to help us come prepared. Can you confirm which of the slots works for you and who from your side will join (product/infra/security/procurement)?

If none of those work, propose 2–3 times and we’ll prioritize.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: nimbus_api_sample_rates.csv

From: James Turner <james.turner@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Santos <elena.santos@nh-prod.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps / calendar sync

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling the sample CSV together. Dec 2 at 2pm PST works for us — locking it in. Attendees from our side: myself (product/infra), Elena (security/compliance), and I’ve looped procurement for contracting discussion if needed.

A couple of extra data points to help you prepare: 
- Our current expected traffic (next 6 months): ~100–140 RPS typical, 350–420 RPS peak.
- Avg tokens per request: ~180 (includes context & response).
- Target P95: <= 300ms for the patient-facing routes; for background batch jobs we can accept higher tail latency.
- Model: we'll start with a 13B open model (latency-sensitive), but want recommendations for quantized variants if that helps reduce cost without breaking quality.

Procurement note: procurement@nimbushealth.com will collect SOC2 + encryption/KMS info. If you can bring your SOC2 summary and your private deployment options to the call that’d be helpful.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

—James
James Turner
Head of Product, Nimbus Health
james.turner@nimbushealth.com | +1 (617) 555-1420

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: James Turner <james.turner@nimbushealth.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@nh-prod.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps / calendar sync

Perfect — thanks James. I’ve created a calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics attached) for Wed, Dec 2, 2:00–3:00pm PST and included the agenda below. Camila (solutions engineering) will lead the sizing portion and come prepared with an initial GPU / commit recommendation based on the numbers you shared.

Agenda (30–60 minutes):
1) Quick intros & goals (5m)
2) Traffic profile & sample payloads (10m)
3) Latency SLOs, batching & quantization options (15m)
4) Security/compliance & procurement asks (10m)
5) Proposed Dedicated configs & next steps (10m)

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf (pricing + commitment tiers)

Camila — can you bring: a short throughput table (RPS vs GPU type), recommended quant/instance options for 13B-class models, and a checklist of what we need from their infra team for a Private deployment?

James / Elena / procurement — if you have any sample payloads or recent production traces you can share ahead of the call that would speed up sizing estimates.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v3.pdf, calendar_invite.ics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Nimbus Health sizing prep (Dec 2 2pm PST)

Quick internal note — call confirmed for Wed Dec 2, 2pm PST with Nimbus Health (James, Elena, procurement).

Camila — please prep:
- Throughput calc (RPS -> GPUs) for 13B model at avg 180 tokens/request and peaks up to 420 RPS
- P95 latency vs batching tradeoffs (numbers we can quote)
- Quantization options and expected cost savings by profile
- Any required infra/network checklist for Private/VPC deployment

Neha — can you surface the SOC2 summary + any recent audits in case procurement asks during the call? I’ll bring the pricing tiers and a draft mutual action plan.

Thanks — Marissa
